title: New Technologies Now Available for Game Developers including DLSS 4.5 Second Generation Transformer Model
author: NV_Tim
selftext:
DLSS 4 introduced a transformer model architecture that enabled a leap in image quality over our previous convolutional neural network. 

Now, the second-gen transformer model for DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution uses 5x more compute and an expanded training data set for greater context awareness of every scene and more intelligent use of pixel sampling and motion vectors.

Access [DLSS](https://developer.nvidia.com/rtx/dlss) Super Resolution with a second-generation transformer model via NVIDIA Streamline Plugin.

Additionally, take advantage of updates to [NVIDIA RTX Neural Texture Compression SDK](https://developer.nvidia.com/rtx-kit/), which brings significant performance improvements including block compression 7 encoding has been sped up by 6x, and inference speed has increased by 20% to 40% compared to version 0.8, allowing developers to minimize FPS impact when saving up to 7x system memory., 

Lastly, [ NVIDIA ACE](https://developer.nvidia.com/ace-for-games). can now leverage Nemotron Nano 9B V2 through an SDK plugin for building conversational in-game characters. The plugin simplifies the integration and optimizes simultaneous AI inference and graphics processing.

See our full list of updates [here](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-dlss-4-5-delivers-super-resolution-upgrades-and-new-dynamic-multi-frame-generation/?linkId=100000402646082). 

**Resources for game developers**: See our full list [here](https://developer.nvidia.com/industries/game-development) and follow us to stay up-to-date with the latest NVIDIA Game development news: 

* Join the [NVIDIA Developer Program](https://developer.nvidia.com/developer-program) (select gaming as your industry)

comments.body: The jump to a second generation transformer for DLSS is impressive, but I am curious how noticeable the gains will be in real world gameplay versus benchmarks.
